triage.site_notes: The site is a bilingual (jp/en) PHP-based gallery site with a single artist roster page (artist.php) and a single comprehensive exhibition list (exhibition.php) that appears to serve as both current and archive listing, supplemented by a dedicated 'current' page (260912.php). Individual exhibition and artist sub-pages exist for each show/artist but are redundant given the roster and archive pages already summarize them, so they are left unlabeled; no distinct fairs or about page was found.
